taxonomy_summary: Crossotarsus flavomaculatus Strohmeyer, 1912. Original description and historical taxonomic treatments are displayed with claim-specific source verification; provisional distribution and host assertions remain separate from nomenclatural decisions.
nomenclature_note: The species was originally described in Crossotarsus by Strohmeyer (1912:40–41); no independently validated additional synonym is currently adopted.

resources.images: No image with confirmed public reuse rights is linked in this release.
resources.specimens: Specimen/type evidence is recorded in the cited original descriptions; specimen accessions have not been independently mapped to online repositories.

provenance.scope: Distribution and host evidence consolidated for website display; separate nomenclatural uncertainties remain recorded.
